page_title: TOR 1-2 CAG | Torino v Cagliari 27/12/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+4' Whoa! Such gestures are commonly penalised and Zakaria Aboukhlal (Torino) duly receives a yellow card.
90+4' GOAL! Wait, the goal by Cyril Ngonge (Torino) is not going to count as the ball ran out of play during the build up.
90+2' Niels Nkounkou (Torino) makes it easy for the referee to show him a yellow card.

90+1' Duvan Zapata sprays a wonderful pass out to Giovanni Simeone (Torino), who cannot get enough power or direction to cause Elia Caprile problems and the goalkeeper is able to watch the ball go just wide of the left post.
90' 5 additional min. will be played.
90' Cyril Ngonge (Torino) takes the corner kick, but Elia Caprile reads it well and stops the effort.

90' Duvan Zapata (Torino) is unmarked in the penalty area and heads the ball towards goal, but the goalkeeper stops his attempt by pulling off a fine save. The ball is out of play. Torino win a corner kick.
88' Zakaria Aboukhlal (Torino) trips an opposition player and Daniele Doveri signals a foul. Cagliari are awarded the free kick.

87' Giovanni Simeone (Torino) attempts to convert a lofted cross as he jumps high and heads the ball to the left side of the goal. Elia Caprile shows his brilliant reflexes and pulls off a glorious save to stop the ball from hitting the net.
86' Niels Nkounkou (Torino) gets the ball and drives a shot high over the bar from the edge of the area.
84' Fabio Pisacane decides to make a substitution. Matteo Prati will be replaced by Adam Obert (Cagliari).

83' Emirhan Ilkhan (Torino) wastes an opportunity. He finds himself in acres of space and fires in a terrific shot from long range straight towards the roof of the net, but the goalkeeper makes a brilliant save and stops this one!
81' Gennaro Borrelli (Cagliari) skips past his man but can't keep the ball in play. The ball goes out of play and Torino will have a goal kick.
80' That's the end of the game for Gvidas Gineitis, who is replaced by Emirhan Ilkhan (Torino).
80' The manager has been forced to make a substitution and the injured Marcus Pedersen (Torino) limps off the pitch to be replaced by Zakaria Aboukhlal.
76' Kristjan Asllani goes off the pitch and Cyril Ngonge (Torino) comes on.
75' Gvidas Gineitis (Torino) places a shot from the edge of the box towards the right side of the goal, but Elia Caprile makes a terrific save to deny him. Nice play all round!
74' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Michel Adopo (Cagliari), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.
72' The players claim that Nikola Vlasic (Torino) handled the ball and it seems they are right.
72' Fabio Pisacane has decided to substitute Semih Kilicsoy and he is replaced by Gennaro Borrelli (Cagliari).
72' The manager has been forced to make a substitution and the injured Luca Mazzitelli (Cagliari) leaves the pitch to be replaced by Nicolo Cavuoti.
71' Nikola Vlasic (Torino) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal.
71' Gvidas Gineitis (Torino) takes the corner kick and sends the ball among a huddle of players inside the penalty area, but one of the defenders clears it to safety.

70' Ardian Ismajli (Torino) peeled away from his marker and got on the end of the corner, but his fine header towards the right post is brilliantly saved by the diving goalkeeper. The referee blows his whistle, Torino are awarded a corner kick.
70' Gvidas Gineitis (Torino) looks like he will be the one to try and deliver a quality ball into the penalty box from the corner kick.
68' That will be all from Gianluca Gaetano who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Sebastiano Esposito (Cagliari).
67' Today's match ends for Valentino Lazaro who will be replaced by Niels Nkounkou (Torino).
67' Marco Baroni has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Duvan Zapata (Torino) replacing Che Adams.
67' Total attempts – 9:9. The number of shots on goal at present is 5:4.

66' 1 - 2 GOAL! Semih Kilicsoy (Cagliari) receives the ball after a swift counter attack. Still with some work to do, he weaves his way through the defence to score a wonderful goal from mid range to make it 1:2.
65' Adrien Tameze (Torino) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Elia Caprile intercepts the ball.
64' Good defending. Kristjan Asllani (Torino) tries to find Nikola Vlasic inside the box, but the pass is cut out.
59' Marcus Pedersen (Torino) strikes the ball towards goal, but it fails to reach the target after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
59' A precise short pass from Gianluca Gaetano releases Semih Kilicsoy (Cagliari) in space inside the box, but he smashes a wild shot well past the left post.
58' Marcus Pedersen (Torino) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.
56' Marco Palestra (Cagliari) commits a foul after unfairly battling his opponent for the ball.
54' Marco Palestra (Cagliari) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
54' Che Adams (Torino) darts into the penalty area to latch on to a pass, and he unleashes a shot towards the roof of the net, but Elia Caprile is alert and denies him with a nice save.

53' Giovanni Simeone (Torino) had a good chance to change the score. He ran towards the goal and unleashed a low shot from long range which went towards the middle of the goal, but Elia Caprile was ready and made a save.
53' Marco Palestra (Cagliari) passes the ball into the box but an opposing player clears.
50' The free kick into the penalty area from Kristjan Asllani (Torino) is cleared.

49' Matteo Prati (Cagliari) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Daniele Doveri blows his whistle for an infringement. Torino will take a free kick near the side line.

47' Nikola Vlasic (Torino) outjumps the defence to meet the resulting corner and heads the ball towards the bottom right corner. The long-range header is not powerful enough, and the keeper comfortably makes a save.
47' Valentino Lazaro (Torino) is about to take a corner kick.
47' Marcus Pedersen (Torino) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence. Torino have been awarded a corner kick.
46' Referee Daniele Doveri blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+4' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+3' Adrien Tameze (Torino) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.

45+2' Sebastiano Luperto (Cagliari) picks the ball up and unleashes a low drive from long range without any hesitation. His shot is directed towards the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper reads it well and makes a fine save.
45+2' Riyad Idrissi (Cagliari) sees an unmarked teammate and attempts to send him a low pass. However, one of the defenders reads the game perfectly and averts the danger.
45' 2 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
45' 1 - 1 GOAL - 1:1! The corner comes over and Luca Mazzitelli flicks on with his head to Matteo Prati (Cagliari), who makes no mistake and fires the ball into the back of the net.
45' Gianluca Gaetano (Cagliari) will deliver the corner kick.
45' Marco Palestra (Cagliari) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. Cagliari will take a corner kick.
44' Valentino Lazaro sends over a penetrating corner which finds the head of Giovanni Simeone (Torino), but his effort from close range is disappointing and goes high over the bar.
44' Valentino Lazaro (Torino) takes the corner.
39' Gianluca Gaetano (Cagliari) takes the corner, but one of the defenders reacts well and rises highest to head the ball away.

38' Semih Kilicsoy (Cagliari) is unable to control an accurate defence-splitting pass properly and one of the defending players reacts well to rob him of the ball. The ball is out of play and Cagliari manage to earn a corner.
37' Che Adams (Torino) tries to play a through ball from just inside the box to Giovanni Simeone, but one of the defending players is alert to the danger and makes a timely interception.
36' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Nikola Vlasic (Torino) was quite harsh and Daniele Doveri didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
35' Semih Kilicsoy (Cagliari) tries to find Gianluca Gaetano, but he puts too much power on the through ball.
33' Matteo Prati (Cagliari) hammers the ball from far out, but his shot is blocked by an opposition player.
31' Fabio Pisacane isn't happy on the touchline after referee Daniele Doveri shows him a yellow card.
31' 3:3 – this is the total number of shots produced by both teams. 2:2 - the latest stats for both teams in respect of shots on target.

28' 1 - 0 Wonderful movement! Che Adams is in a good position inside the box but decides to pass the ball to Nikola Vlasic (Torino), who keeps his cool and blasts the ball into the top left corner. What a finish that is – 1:0.

27' Giovanni Simeone (Torino) receives a precise low pass inside the box, controls the ball and releases it towards the left post. Unfortunately for him, Elia Caprile makes a great save to stop his effort.
26' Luca Mazzitelli (Cagliari) is penalised for holding. Daniele Doveri signals a set piece. Torino are given an advantage. They have a free kick.
25' Kristjan Asllani (Torino) takes the corner, but the opposition's defence is ready and clears the ball to safety.
24' Marcus Pedersen (Torino) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety. It will be a corner kick for Torino.
24' Kristjan Asllani (Torino) puts a cross into the box from the free kick but it's cleared.

23' Gianluca Gaetano (Cagliari) latches on to a precise pass and finds himself one-on-one with the keeper. He fires a low shot towards the left side of the net, but Alberto Paleari leaps like a salmon to deny him.
22' Gvidas Gineitis (Torino) put a cross into the box which wasn't a bad decision, but he failed to achieve what he wanted as none of his teammates managed to meet it.
19' Giovanni Simeone (Torino) makes a driving run into the box but he cannot work any space for a shot. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Cagliari.
18' Adrien Tameze (Torino) and Che Adams try to prise open the opposition with a series of short passes, but one of the defenders steps in and puts an end to the move.
16' The ball is cleared after Che Adams (Torino) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
16' The ratio of the ball possession is 59:41.
15' Valentino Lazaro (Torino) is penalised for a foul. Daniele Doveri had a clear view and blows his whistle.
15' Torino enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
12' Here comes the ref’s decision after the VAR review. It’s not penalty to Cagliari as the referee indicates there was no infringement!
10' There's a break in play and referee Daniele Doveri must have got a signal in his ear as he indicates he will check that earlier penalty claim by Cagliari using VAR. This could be interesting!
9' Riyad Idrissi (Cagliari) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
8' Riyad Idrissi (Cagliari) is caught offside, but it was a really close call.
8' Riyad Idrissi (Cagliari) goes down under a challenge in the box, but the ref immediately waves away the appeals from all players.
7' Che Adams (Torino) collects a pass inside the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender.
5' Kristjan Asllani (Torino) fails to deliver a decent cross from a long-range free kick. The opposition's defence intercepts the effort.
4' Daniele Doveri blows his whistle for a foul after Sebastiano Luperto (Cagliari) hacks down one of his opponents. Torino have a free kick.
4' Marco Palestra (Cagliari) gets on the ball and beats an opponent, but his run is stopped by the referee Daniele Doveri who sees an offensive foul.
3' Nikola Vlasic (Torino) clearly holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
1' The match has just started.
Cagliari will kick-off.
Daniele Doveri is introduced as the referee for today's match.
